Game Overview

At its heart, Memory Master is a memory game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Memory Master comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Memory Master?

Memory Master is a free memory game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Memory Master free to play?

Yes, Memory Master is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
